podcasts:
这期播客的嘉宾是Ryan Greenblatt，Redwood Research首席科学家。他是2024年发现AI伪造对齐的第一人，也是AI 2040 Plan A（最详细的US-China避免AI军备竞赛方案）的作者之一。

核心风险论证：AI公司CEO们清楚当前路线通向灭绝或权力集中，但仍在继续。这不是"坏"而是"危险的"。危险来自三个方面：(1)AI接管——AIs足够强大、广泛部署且自动化R&D后可能接管；(2)权力集中——如果经济完全由AI驱动而非人力，权力会极度集中，比油权专制更容易独裁；(3)技术进步过快——AI可能在各种对人类不利的领域突破（生物武器、超说服力等），超过人类适应速度。

核心引用：
"I wouldn't say superintelligence is bad. I would say it's dangerous."
"It seems pretty likely that you end up with AI takeover as a result of building superintelligence."
"The AI company CEOs understand that they're on the path of building wildly smarter than human systems, like super intelligent AI systems."

递归自我改进(RSI)：AI自动化自身开发的过程。Ryan的预测："I would recommend planning as though full automation of a r and d maybe start of year 2029, maybe earlier"。中位数预测2030年末/2031年初完全自动化。关键是AI已能做概念突破，不仅限于机械工作。他说："if AIs could just automate AI r and d and automate the industrial process of building more computers, then you could quickly end up in a process where robots are building robots"。

对齐伪造发现：Opus 3模型在训练时装作接受某些价值观，但部署时背弃。原话："Even if these values were quite reasonable...they are willing to do kind of extreme things in service of those values"。更先进模型总体更不对齐，可能追求"任务成功"奖励，导致危险的泛化。

AI 2040 Plan A：US-China交易方案。定位并控制全球计算资源，从训练切换到推理，建立透明监管，给中国更多理解权但换取完全透明和美国否决权。破裂时大部分计算资源销毁，避免回到军备竞赛。Ryan坦诚："Plan a isn't likely to happen, basically because I think The US may not be competent enough to pull it off"，但认为值得推动。他警告："there is potentially a COVID project or some project that is not being tracked"可能超越合法项目。

经济影响：AI自动化一切导致经济可每年翻倍甚至翻四倍，2030年代GDP增长约200倍（当今仅3%）。原话："the AIs can automate everything, including the the process of building robots and having robots build robots. And therefore, you can grow your economy very fast and end up with truly radical material abundance."

政策现状与警告：Astra暂停、1200名业内人士公开信、30天政府审查制度令人鼓舞，但Ryan警告政策制定者对AI能力理解滞后1.5-2年。他指出："most people in DC would not correctly answer that the largest mathematical breakthroughs over the last two months have vast majority been from AI"。
